Section 1.2 Insured's Declared Value
IDV is the manufacturer's listed selling price of the vehicle, including accessories fitted by the manufacturer, less depreciation based on the age of the vehicle: up to 6 months - 5%; 6 months to 1 year - 15%; 1 to 2 years - 20%; 2 to 3 years - 30%; 3 to 4 years - 40%; 4 to 5 years - 50%. For vehicles older than 5 years, IDV is agreed between the Company and the insured based on the vehicle's condition and market value.

Section 2.1 Own Damage Cover
The Company shall indemnify the insured for loss of or damage to the insured vehicle caused by fire, explosion, self-ignition, lightning, burglary, theft, riot, strike, malicious act, terrorism, earthquake, flood, cyclone, storm, inundation, landslide, rockslide, accidental external means, and whilst in transit by road, rail, inland waterway, lift, elevator or air. Standard depreciation on parts replaced applies unless the Zero Depreciation add-on is opted.

Section 2.3 Depreciation Schedule for Parts
Depreciation on parts replaced: rubber, nylon, plastic, tyres, tubes and batteries - 50%; fibreglass - 30%; glass - nil. Metal parts by vehicle age: up to 6 months - nil; 6 months to 1 year - 5%; 1 to 2 years - 10%; 2 to 3 years - 15%; 3 to 4 years - 25%; 4 to 5 years - 35%; 5 to 10 years - 40%; above 10 years - 50%.

Section 3.1 Third Party Liability
The Company shall cover the insured's legal liability for death or bodily injury to third parties without limit as required under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, and for damage to third-party property up to Rs 7,50,000 per accident.

Section 4.1 Exclusions
No claim is payable for: damage outside the geographical area; use of the vehicle for hire or reward, racing, pace-making or speed testing unless specifically covered; driving without a valid licence or under the influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs; normal wear and tear, depreciation, mechanical or electrical breakdown; consequential loss including engine damage from water ingress unless the Engine Protect add-on is opted; war, nuclear risks and radioactive contamination.

Section 5.1 No Claim Bonus
NCB is allowed on the own damage premium for each claim-free year: 20%, 25%, 35%, 45% and 50% for one to five or more consecutive claim-free years respectively. A claim in the policy year reduces the NCB to nil at renewal. NCB lapses if the policy is not renewed within 90 days of expiry. NCB belongs to the insured, not the vehicle, and can be transferred to a replacement vehicle of the same class.

Section 6.1 Claim Intimation and Settlement
Claims must be intimated within 24 hours of the incident through the IL TakeCare app, website or 24x7 call centre. Theft must be reported to the police immediately and an FIR copy submitted. Cashless settlement is available at network garages after survey; reimbursement claims are settled within 7 working days of receipt of all documents. Required documents: claim form, RC copy, driving licence, policy copy, FIR where applicable, and repair invoices.

Section 7.1 Zero Depreciation Add-on
Depreciation on parts replaced will not be deducted from an admissible own damage claim. Available for vehicles up to 7 years old. Unlimited claims are allowed per policy year; however, from the third claim onwards an additional deductible of Rs 1,000 per claim applies. Tyres and tubes are excluded unless damaged in an accident along with other parts.

Section 7.2 Engine Protect
Covers damage to the engine, gearbox and differential caused by water ingression, hydrostatic lock or leakage of lubricating oil following an accident. Available for vehicles up to 7 years old. A deductible of 5% of the admissible claim amount applies. Not covered: wear and tear, manufacturing defects, and losses covered under the manufacturer's warranty.

Section 7.3 Roadside Assistance
Available 24x7 across India: towing up to 100 km to the nearest authorised workshop, flat tyre support, battery jump-start, emergency fuel up to 5 litres (fuel charges payable by the insured), spare key pick-up and drop, and on-site minor repairs up to 30 minutes of labour. Up to 5 services per policy year.

Section 7.4 Consumables Cover
Reimburses the cost of consumables such as engine oil, gearbox oil, coolant, brake fluid, AC refrigerant gas, nuts, bolts, screws, clips, washers and grease used in the repair of the insured vehicle following an admissible own damage claim. Fuel and parts replaced during routine servicing are excluded.

Section 7.5 Return to Invoice
In case of theft or total loss, pays the gap between the IDV and the original invoice price of the vehicle, including registration charges and road tax. Available for vehicles up to 4 years old.

Section 7.6 Key Protect
Covers the cost of replacing lost, stolen or damaged keys and, if needed, the lock set, up to Rs 50,000 per policy year. Limited to 1 claim per policy year. Includes locksmith charges if the vehicle is locked out.
